articles.headline: World Cup Daily live: Cape Verde scores equalizer against Uruguay
articles.description: Another World Cup day, with four more exciting matchups. First up, Lamine Yamal is back in the starting XI for Spain against Saudi Arabia.

articles.headline: Lamine Yamal scores maiden World Cup goal for Spain
articles.description: Eighteen-year-old Lamine Yamal becomes the eighth-youngest scorer in men's World Cup history in Spain's 4-0 win over Saudi Arabia.

articles.headline: Lucas Paqueta: Brazil have 'great respect' for Scotland
articles.description: Brazil playmaker Lucas Paquetá says he has "great respect" for Scotland ahead of the decisive clash between the teams in Miami on Wednesday.

articles.headline: Iran played 'beautiful game' vs. Belgium under 'worst' conditions
articles.description: Iran coach Amir Ghalenoei said his team played a "beautiful game" under the worst possible conditions in their 0-0 draw with Belgium at SoFi Stadium on Sunday.

articles.headline: Austria's Stefan Posch will play vs. Argentina despite broken jaw
articles.description: Austria defender Stefan Posch will be available to play Monday against defending champion Argentina after sustaining a broken jaw in his team's win to open this World Cup.

articles.headline: 'Opinions are going to be there' - Jedinak defends Socceroo approach, looks ahead to Paraguay
